example_sentences_in_bangla: সংসারের খোরাক কম নয়, সবাই সুখে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The household's food provisions are plentiful, everyone is content.
Buy some groceries from the market.
note: This term is often used in everyday Bengali speech to refer to household food supplies, rooted in rural and semi-urban lifestyles.
